title: Structure-Guided Spatiotemporal Attention Graph Neural Network for Traffic Flow Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.14177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep spatiotemporal models integrating graph convolutions and attention mechanisms have demonstrated excellent performance in network-level traffic flow prediction, owing to their exceptional ability to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies. Despite their predictive success, deployment of such models in safety-critical urban systems remains constrained by their inherent lack of transparency. Existing post-hoc diagnostic methods often struggle with spurious correlations and fail to unveil the intrinsic decision-making mechanisms governing traffic dynamics, resulting in suboptimal interpretability and limited operational trustworthiness. To address these challenges, this paper proposes the Structure-Guided Spatiotemporal Attention Graph Neural Network (SGSAN). translated_title: 结构引导的时空注意力图神经网络用于交通流预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14177v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：结合图卷积和注意力机制的深度时空模型，凭借其捕获复杂时空依赖关系的卓越能力，在网络级交通流预测中表现出色。尽管预测性能优异，但由于其固有的缺乏透明性，此类模型在安全关键的城市系统中的部署仍受到限制。现有的后验诊断方法常常受虚假相关性困扰，无法揭示控制交通动态的内在决策机制，导致可解释性欠佳和运行可信度有限。为应对这些挑战，本文提出结构引导的时空注意力图神经网络（SGSAN）。不同于依赖无约束自适应图的传统架构，SGSAN显式学习一个静态有向依赖图（DDG），以识别不变性。
tldr: 本文提出SGSAN模型，通过显式学习静态有向依赖图来增强交通流预测的可解释性，克服传统模型缺乏透明性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SGSAN, which enhances interpretability in traffic flow prediction by explicitly learning a static directed dependency graph, addressing the lack of transparency in traditional models.
